in_sanskrit.name: नलकूबर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nala was a king who was exiled and cursed to become a serpent. He became the king of the Naga serpents and was known as Nalakuber.

in_marathi.name: Nalakuber
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Nalas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nalakuber हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nalakuber is a name of Lord Vishnu, meaning the Lord of the Nalas.

in_bengali.name: Nalakuber
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Nalas
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nalakuber একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Nalakuber is a name of Lord Vishnu, meaning the Lord of the Nalas.
